answer: Require each identity to maintain a kernel of verified compute that it must expose for audit on demand. The kernel is a compact, self-contained proof of work whose validity can be checked in milliseconds but whose generation requires sustained honest effort. A tundra of fresh clones cannot seed the kernel fast enough, because each must redo the work from scratch. The crystal of that proof then becomes the anchor for reputation, and the cost of duplication scales with the depth of the kernel.
